title: NagaWorld workers’ strike and recurring daily public demonstrations
location: NagaWorld casino-hotel complex and nearby central Phnom Penh sites
organizer: Labor Rights Supported Union of Khmer Employees of NagaWorld (LRSU)

start_date.summary: CamboJA S018 says NagaWorld employees had been striking since late November. RFA S034 says the strike had drawn hundreds since Dec. 18; RFA S015 also dates cumulative participation to Dec. 18; LICADHO S002 says daily peaceful demonstrations began one month before Jan. 18 (about Dec. 18); CamboJA S019 reports Dec. 19. This may distinguish an earlier work stoppage from the later daily public-demonstration phase; keep the exact relationship and start unresolved.

location.summary: Reports place workers around the NagaWorld complex and Australian Embassy in central Phnom Penh, with Jan. 3 action across nearby sites; exact continuity of location across each afternoon is not established.

notes: January reporting describes recurring NagaWorld strike demonstrations before the month. The earlier stored Dec. 2021 start date is retained for the daily public-action phase, but S018 says the broader strike began in late November; Jan. 3/4/6 remain dated January observations pending unit review. RFA and LICADHO place daily actions around Dec. 18; CamboJA gives Dec. 19. Do not infer uninterrupted physical assembly or a single exact onset.
